response.evidence: Using Nano Stores in the frontmatter of server-side components is not recommended because of the following restrictions: Writing to a store from a .astro file or non-hydrated component will not affect the value received by client-side components . You cannot pass a Nano Store as a “prop” to client-side components. You cannot subscribe to store changes from a .astro file, since Astro components do not re-render.
response.rationale: The FAQ lists exactly these three restrictions as the reason for advising against using Nano Stores in server-side component frontmatter, which matches option 1.
